source_text: 越来越多的中国人现在的确离不开手机了。他们中的许多人，包括老年人，都使用手机应用程序(apps)保持联 系并拓宽朋友圈。他们也用手机购物、查找信息，因为手机便于携带。此外，使用手机应用程序通信比传统电话便 宜。然而，这种新趋势导致人们在社交时过度依赖手机。事实上，一些年轻人已经变得十分上瘾，以至于忽视了与 家人和朋友面对面的交流。
reference_translation: Indeed, more and more Chinese people can't do without their mobile phones nowadays. Many of them, including the elderly, use mobile applications (apps) to stay connected and expand their circle of friends. They also use their phones to shop and search for information because mobile phones are easy to carry. Moreover, communicating via mobile apps is cheaper than using traditional phones. However, this new trend has led people to rely too much on their phones in social interactions. In fact, some young people have become so addicted that they neglect face-to-face communication with their family and friends.
